stem.text: The Michaelis–Menten constant, $K_\text{m}$, is a measure of the affinity of an enzyme for its substrate.

items: The higher the affinity, the lower the $K_\text{m}$.
The lower the affinity, the slower the reaction will be.
At $K_\text{m}$, half the active sites of the enzyme are occupied by the substrate.
